extracted.stage: Before grant of probate; inheritance tax due
extracted.summary: An executor seeks around £108,500 to pay inheritance tax on her late father's estate, which is mainly a house in Bath valued at about £361,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the detail you have already provided. To take this further we will need a copy of the will and confirmation of your appointment as executor, the IHT400 or equivalent calculation showing the tax due, and evidence of the property valuation and any outstanding mortgage or charges. It would also help to have details of the estate's other assets and liabilities, and written confirmation from Fenwick & Sallow Solicitors that they are instructed and happy to liaise with us. Once we have these, a member of our team will review the information and come back to you. Please let us know if you have any questions in the meantime.
